source.note: Generated object asset names are best-effort semantic identifications. Runtime mappings intentionally cover only direct or defensible content matches; all other overworld object types keep procedural marker fallbacks. Live terrain uses the original authored quiet tile bank and procedural special-terrain fallback. The extracted HoMM3 atlas and generated renderer-study payloads remain local reference material and are excluded from official packages.

encounter_signature_reed_totemists.accessible_description: A crooked cluster of reed poles carries a carved boar-jaw mask, bone chimes, moss, and an amber ward lantern.

encounter_signature_archive_wardens.accessible_description: An iron-bound red field archive stands beneath an amber lantern between two short warding pikes.

encounter_signature_relay_pickets.accessible_description: A pale-gold prism and two mirrored signal vanes rise behind three cord-linked ivory boundary stakes.

encounter_signature_graftroot_wardens.accessible_description: Two antler-like living roots and a copper thorn loop guard a luminous green sapstone.

encounter_signature_orevein_exactors.accessible_description: A black iron assay tripod carries brass scales above a hot sample crucible and locked ore strongbox.

encounter_signature_bellwake_privateers.accessible_description: A leaning weathered mast holds a dark ship bell, torn teal pennant, anchor hook, rope, and pale harbor lantern.

encounter_recurring_beacon_wardens.accessible_description: A tall brass-bound signal mast carries three ember lanterns, a blue charter pennant, and four warding pikes.

encounter_recurring_bridgeward_levies.accessible_description: Two squat stone piers brace a red toll beam, blue pavise, ember lantern, and fan of four levy pikes.

encounter_recurring_aurora_battery.accessible_description: Three horizontal cyan-violet prism lances sit on a low ivory turntable with pale-gold stabilizer fins.

encounter_recurring_bone_ferry_watch.accessible_description: A crooked bone-prowed skiff rests on bog stilts beneath rib hooks, a peat lantern, hide drum, and torn reed pennant.

encounter_recurring_charter_guard.accessible_description: A broad red command canopy shelters a sealed charter lectern and supply chests behind short crenellated pavises.

encounter_recurring_mirror_lancers.accessible_description: Three mirrored lances cross above two opposing faceted shields, a crescent rack, and a split blue aurora pennant.

encounter_recurring_drum_circle.accessible_description: Four taut hide war drums ring a tall split nightglass pylon beneath a crooked peat lantern and bone-strung reed lines.

encounter_recurring_gate_marshals.accessible_description: Two blackwood gate posts hold a spiked chain boom between bone horns, narrow hide pennants, and a mud-brick watch plinth.

encounter_recurring_charter_bastion_rese.accessible_description: Three red brass-edged pavises defend a sealed charter standard, upright pike rack, supply chests, and low ember brazier.

encounter_recurring_ford_reavers.accessible_description: Two narrow blackwood skiffs flank a stepping-stone ford beneath crossed hooked boarding poles, reed arrows, and a torn rush-red pennant.

encounter_recurring_glasswing_sortie.accessible_description: Two swept translucent glass wings rise from an ivory launch rack with a central prism lance, angled rails, tuning fork, and split cobalt pennant.

encounter_recurring_hollow_mire.accessible_description: A deep peat sink yawns inside leaning root ribs and two mudglass perches beneath a cold fog lantern and narrow plank approach.

encounter_recurring_silt_hunters.accessible_description: Three huge mud-caked jaw traps radiate from a hooked blade rack, weighted reed nets, and two cloudy mudglass range stakes.

encounter_recurring_tidepool_skiffyard_w.accessible_description: Three narrow tide skiffs rest on tilted tarred racks beside a rope winch, reefbolt stand, supply chest, and tall shell-marked tide gauge.

encounter_recurring_survey_guard.accessible_description: A tall brass survey tripod stands over a charter map table beside a narrow pavise, three river pikes, compass chain, and ember lantern.

encounter_recurring_road_chaplains.accessible_description: A two-wheeled brass-bound road shrine carries twin ember lanterns, an open hymn lectern, supply cases, and a disciplined fan of pikes.

encounter_recurring_mill_levies.accessible_description: A broad half mill wheel rises behind grain sacks, three short brass-edged pavises, levy pikes, a flour chest, and an ember lantern.

encounter_recurring_reedbarrow_chain.accessible_description: A massive sagging ferry chain hangs between unequal peat-stone stanchions above levee stakes, sling bolts, a hooked winch, and torn rush flags.

encounter_recurring_nightglass_dominion.accessible_description: Three jagged nightglass spires form a dark crown behind a clawed peat palisade, central hide command drum, bone lanterns, and hooked walls.

encounter_recurring_mirror_causeway.accessible_description: Cracked silver-black mirror slabs step diagonally between hooked reed pilings, crossed harrow hooks, a bloodwake drum, and torn rush pennant.

encounter_recurring_halo_reserve.accessible_description: A large concentric prism halo stands in an ivory tuning rack above four faceted shields, a horizontal aurora bolt, and resonant chimes.

encounter_recurring_daybreak_matrix.accessible_description: Four short corner prisms connect by pale-gold rails to a tall central daybreak beacon, shelter fins, and a compact relay depot.

encounter_recurring_daybreak_array.accessible_description: Three long sunlance mirrors fan outward on elevated ivory rails from a low turntable beneath a tuning chime and split cobalt pennant.

encounter_recurring_basalt_gatehouse_wat.accessible_description: A thick black-basalt arch encloses an amber-lit tunnel throat and iron portcullis between twin bolter buttresses and a heavy chain winch.

encounter_recurring_barrow_pickets.accessible_description: Two uneven rows of tall hooked reed pikes rise from a peat barrow behind a squat hide drum, clawed palisade, and bent stone marker.

encounter_recurring_bramble_hedge_watch.accessible_description: A raised wicker watch basket overlooks a crescent thorn hedge, crossed thornbow rests, and a chained root-wrapped stone vault hatch.

encounter_recurring_lantern_patrol.accessible_description: A forked signal mast with stacked amber lanterns stands above a three-lamp brass range battery, red pavises, and road pikes.

encounter_recurring_reedward_camp.accessible_description: A forked torch beacon towers over an asymmetric reed-and-hide shelter, snare stakes, violet sling bolts, and a shallow peat supply sled.

encounter_recurring_sluice_raiders.accessible_description: A broken diagonal timber sluice spans unequal peat-and-stone posts beside a claw-shaped crank wheel, channel planks, hook rack, and signal drum.

encounter_recurring_willow_mill_pack.accessible_description: A leaning willow embraces a cracked half waterwheel and millstone above a low hide awning, sling-stone basket, and paired claw hooks.

encounter_recurring_ghoul_grove.accessible_description: Three crooked hollow blackbranch trunks rise like claws behind a thorn-woven earth berm, sling nest, paired fog jars, and stone-veil cairn.
